# Codex Studio 0.1.21
## ChatGPT 26.915 compatibility
- Restores centered welcome text for the current ChatGPT home heading. - Removes the extra project-picker label from the welcome sentence and keeps long project names within the available width. - Includes DreamSkin runtime 1.9.7 and the task-rendering safeguards added after 0.1.20. - Refreshes an older background theme engine during apply so an app update cannot immediately revert to the previous runtime.
## Local library continuity
- Keeps locally cached Apple wallpaper packs visible and available after installing a release update. Their artwork stays on this Mac and is not redistributed in the update.
Your imported themes, drafts, favorites, and local wallpaper library are preserved.

# Codex Studio 0.1.20
## Capability-aware runtime
- Aligns the injector's reported version with the bundled `DreamSkinRuntime/VERSION` file so shell, payload, and renderer diagnostics share one source of truth. - Adds explicit DevTools target classification so the main Codex page, avatar composition surface, external pages, and embedded webviews stay separate. - Adds a read-only Codex capability check for the installed app version/build, loopback renderer, bundled Node and CLI versions, app-server support, and declared feature flags. - Keeps runtime inspection bounded and local-only; it never attaches to a renderer, starts app-server, or reads account content.
## Studio polish
- Adds a Connection settings capability panel with clearer health, renderer, package, and feature status. - Makes the navigation rail opaque so the Codex window behind Studio cannot bleed through its labels and selection states. - Extends safe diagnostics with compatibility and renderer-target context without including prompts, artwork bytes, or credentials.

# Codex Studio 0.1.19
## Abstract wallpaper library
- Added on-demand MoeWalls Abstract browsing with larger artwork cards, source-aware quality choices, and a crash-safe WebKit animation preview. - Added sorting by Recommended, Newest, Name, Largest preview, and Recently viewed. - Added filters for All wallpapers, Imported, Favorites, and Large previews, with persistent selections and local status badges. - Added a bounded recently-viewed list and cached local-library status checks so the gallery stays responsive as the catalog grows. - Kept the catalog source-only: wallpapers remain downloaded only when the user imports one, avoiding release-bundle bloat.
## Reliability
- Improved unavailable-source errors so failed downloads return to the quality sheet with actionable guidance and preserve the attempted choice. - Verified the new Abstract controls, filtering counts, alphabetical ordering, and sort/filter persistence after relaunch.
